questions.question: The `<title>` tag goes inside the `<body>` section.
questions.explanation: The `<title>` belongs in the `<head>` because it's metadata, not visible content.

questions.question: Which tag should be used for the most important heading of a page?
questions.explanation: <h1> is the top‑level heading; there should be only one per page for good SEO.

questions.question: HTML comments are visible to anyone who views the page source.
questions.explanation: Yes, comments appear in the source code (View > Source). Never put sensitive information in them.

questions.question: What is the correct way to nest a second-level unordered list?
options: Place the new <ul> directly inside the outer <ul>
Place the new <ul> inside an <li> of the outer list
Add a <ul> inside a <li> without closing the outer <ul>
questions.correctAnswer: Place the new <ul> inside an <li> of the outer list
questions.explanation: A nested list must be placed inside a parent `<li>` element, before its closing tag.

questions.question: Which HTML entity would you use to display a less‑than sign (<) in text?
questions.explanation: < stands for less‑than and renders as < on the page.

questions.question: The `id` attribute can be used multiple times on the same page as long as it's on different element types.
questions.explanation: `id` values must be unique across the entire page, regardless of element type.

questions.question: What does the `title` attribute on an `<abbr>` element do?
options: Provides the full expansion of the abbreviation, shown as a tooltip
questions.correctAnswer: Provides the full expansion of the abbreviation, shown as a tooltip
questions.explanation: `<abbr title="HyperText Markup Language">HTML</abbr>` displays the expansion on hover.
